_comment: Known-good feel. CI asserts tools/probe.tscn --suite=movement against these, so a change to how the character moves cannot land silently. Changing feel is allowed; changing it ACCIDENTALLY is not, so a real change means editing this file in the same commit and saying why. Measured at physics_hz 60 with --fixed-fps 60; the tolerance is one physics frame (16.667 ms) where a value is time, and a hair over float noise where it is not.

_notes.jump_apex_height_held: Should track the player's exported jump_height (1.6) closely. If this drifts toward jump_apex_height, variable jump height has broken.
_notes.jump_apex_height: A tapped jump. Must stay clearly BELOW the held value or the jump cut is doing nothing.
